QuestInfo.name: [Phantom Forest] Woods of Shadow
QuestInfo.0: Riman says he senses an ominous energy coming from deeper inside the forest. What could be the source of this murderous pall that hangs over these haunted woods?
QuestInfo.1: Riman says he senses an ominous energy coming from deeper inside the forest. What could be the source of this murderous pall that hangs over these haunted woods?
QuestInfo.2: A mysterious headless horseman attacked you. You were frozen in place with fear, but were able to eke out an escape thanks to Garnet. Her help seems essential to make headway in this forest, but she seems to have a limit on how many times she can use her powers each day.
